source.title: WCA Asian Championship 2018 on August 17 - 19, 2018 in Taipei, Taiwan
source.content: The [WCA Asian Championship 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AsianChampionship2018) will take place on August 17 - 19, 2018 in Taipei, Taiwan. Check out the [WCA Asian Championship 2018 website](https://cubing-tw.net/event/2018AsianChampionship/) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2018 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛将于 8 月 17–19 日在台湾台北举行
translation.content: [2018 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AsianChampionship2018)将于 2018 年 8 月 17–19 日在台湾台北举行。详情及报名请查看[赛事官网](https://cubing-tw.net/event/2018AsianChampionship/)。
